name: engineering-principles
description: Portable engineering principles for boundaries, idempotence, verification, concurrency, and reusable automation.

interface.longDescription: A compact set of portable principles for validating at boundaries, designing idempotent operations, sequencing verifiable units, separating shared state, and building rerunnable automation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply the smallest engineering principles that make this change safer, more testable, and easier to rerun.
